en: Points of Controversy The Great Fifty-Section The Fourth Chapter
Is one worthy [of offerings] together with rebirth? Yes, one is.
"Is one a stream-enterer simultaneously with rebirth?
"One should not say so...
[and so on] "...Is one an arahant simultaneously with rebirth?"
“Yes,” you say.
“Is one a once-returner simultaneously with rebirth?
You should not say so… [and so on].
Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth? Yes.
Is one a Non-returner simultaneously with rebirth?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is it not the case that one is not a stream-enterer at the very moment of rebirth?
Yes, it is.
If one is not a stream-enterer at the moment of rebirth, then indeed, it should not be said that "one is an arahant at the moment of rebirth.
Is it not the case that one is not a once-returner at the moment of rebirth?
“Yes.
[The opponent asks: “If it is true that one does not become a once-returner simultaneously with rebirth, then indeed you should not say:
‘One becomes an arahant simultaneously with rebirth.’”
Is it not the case that one does not become a non-returner simultaneously with rebirth?
Yes, it is so.
If indeed one does not become a non-returner simultaneously with rebirth, then certainly you should not say:
“One who is an Arahant at the very moment of rebirth.
Is one an Arahant at the very moment of rebirth? Yes.
Is the elder Sāriputta an Arahant from the moment of his rebirth?
One should not say so.
Is the elder Mahāmoggallāna ... [and so on] ...? One should not say so.
The elder Mahākassapa …pe… the elder Mahākaccāna …pe… the elder Mahākoṭṭhika …pe…
Is the Elder Mahāpanthaka an Arahant at the moment of rebirth?
One should not say so…pe….
Is the Elder Sāriputta not an Arahant at the moment of rebirth?
“Yes.
“If it is true that the Elder Sāriputta was not an Arahant at the moment of his rebirth, then indeed you should not say:
‘He was an Arahant at the moment of his rebirth.’”
The elder Mahāmoggallāna …pe… the elder Mahākassapa …pe… the elder Mahākaccāna …pe…
Is the elder Mahākoṭṭhika...
[and] the elder Mahāpanthaka an Arahant by birth? Yes.
If the Elder Mahāpanthaka was not an Arahant at the moment of rebirth, then indeed it should not be said that "one is an Arahant at the moment of rebirth.
Is one an Arahant at the moment of rebirth?
“Yes,” you say.
“Does one realize arhatship by means of a mind that is born of rebirth, which is mundane, with taints, and so forth, up to: subject to defilement?
You should not speak thus... [and so on].
Is one an Arahant at the very moment of rebirth?
Yes. Is the consciousness at the time of rebirth leading-outward, tending toward destruction, tending toward enlightenment, tending toward diminution, and free from taints? ... [and so on] ... Yes.
“Is it undefiled?
“One should not say so.

… [as before] … “Is it not the case that the mind at the moment of rebirth is non-leading, does not lead to the destruction [of suffering], does not lead to enlightenment, does not lead to diminution, and is with taints? … [as before] …
Is it subject to defilement? Yes.

If the mind pertaining to rebirth is non-emancipating, not leading to destruction, not leading to enlightenment, not leading to diminution, possessed of taints … [and so on] … subject to defilement, then indeed, sir, you should not say: [that it is not].
“One who is an Arahant at the moment of rebirth.
Is one an Arahant at the moment of rebirth? Yes.
Does one abandon lust, abandon hatred, abandon delusion, and abandon lack of moral dread by means of a mind that is subject to rebirth?
One should not say so… [as before] … Is one an Arahant simultaneously with rebirth?
“Yes,” you say.

“Is the mind that is to be attained through rebirth the Path, the foundation of mindfulness, … the right effort, … the basis of psychic power, … the faculty, … the power, … or the factor of enlightenment?
You must not say so … [and so on].
Is one an Arahant immediately upon rebirth? Yes.
Does one, by means of the mind belonging to that rebirth, fully understand suffering, abandon its origin, realize its cessation, and develop the path?
It should not be said thus … [as before] … Is one an Arahant simultaneously with birth? Yes.
Is cuti-consciousness, path-consciousness, rebirth-linking consciousness, and fruition-consciousness [identical]?
One should not say so... [etc.
...The Discussion on Rebirth-Linking is finished.
